title: Void Metal
description: Yet Another Endgame Material Tier Found in The End - Inspired by Thaumcraft
body:
# Void Metal
## Yet Another Ancient-Debris-But-in-The-End material!

**Void Metal** is material used to upgrade **Netherite** Items to a more powerful variant. It is directly inspired by [Voidmetal from **Thaumcraft 4**](https://thaumcraft-4.fandom.com/wiki/Voidmetal). That means it has _all*_ the properties of Voidmetal from TC4, such as:
- Unbreakable
- Apply Weakness I for 5 seconds on hit
- Sap life and heal yourself when hitting with a Voidmetal Sword

_*warping effects are not included_

Properties are slightly above Netherite tier, except enchantability, which is comparable to Gold Items.

## Obtaining

![Render of a Pickaxe with a Smithing recipe by its side](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/915eb5c9254bd327ecdd77dde6f59c240e97f516_0.webp)

Use **Void Metal Ingot** and a **Voidmetal Upgrade Smithing Template** along with a Netherite item of choice in a **Smithing Table** and you've got youself a fancy new gear.

You can find the required Smithing Template with a small chance in End City chests. You can also duplicate existing templates in the same way as Vanilla Smithing Templates.

The Ingot itself is obtained from Voidmetal Nuggets, which drop from Void Metal Ore.

The Ore can be found somewhat commonly in a thin slice between Y: -16 and Y: 24 in The End dimension, meaning in vanilla generation they can be found right under the End Islands, including the main island. I will let you discover how to get there! ([A Happy Ghast perhaps?](https://modrinth.com/mod/vanillabackport))

![Render of a Voidmetal armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3f4ef1241271e3840309191584a6859cd69229fa_0.webp)

Since Voidmetal items are unbreakable, if your source item happens to have Mending or Unbreaking enchantments of any level, you will get them back in a form of Enchanted Book on craft.
